import json, os
os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

 s.record_start()
 p=s.skill('pick', target_entity_name='tulip')

 print('AFTER_PICK', json.dumps(s.state(), indent=2))
 print('STATUS1', json.dumps(s.status(), indent=2))
 if s.status().get('success'):
  acts=s.record_stop(); s.save_trajectory(acts, '/app/output/trajectory.npz'); raise SystemExit
 q=s.skill('place', target_container_name='vase_seen')
 print('PLACE', json.dumps(q, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x,'tolist') else str(x), indent=2))
 print('FINAL', json.dumps(s.status(), indent=2))
 acts=s.record_stop()
 print('ACTIONS', acts.shape)
 if s.status().get('success'):
  s.save_trajectory(acts, '/app/output/trajectory.npz')
 else:
  print('NOT_SUCCESS; not submitting yet')
PY
